baseline: N4 (decisions-ui-reimplementation-2026-07-26.md) — the SHIPPED-BEHAVIOUR baseline. CORRECTED 2026-08-07: this field previously read 'supersedes Figma; file 5vWxC85QBhqbzPU30RP7LH re-verified 2026-08-06 and holds no product screens'. That is FALSE. The operator showed the file's Pages list: an ELITEA-UI section (Sidebar Menu, Onboarding, Maintenance Page, Import Modal, Announcement Banner, Support ChatBot, Responsive Behavior, Empty State Pages, Modals, Errors, Login, Feedback Popover (NPS), Light Theme screens), plus '*** Colors', '*** Cards redesign guide', '*** Improvements', and AGENT HUB / CHAT / AGENTS sections covering the surfaces being reimplemented. The 'one Cover frame' finding came from a quota-exhausted View-seat inspection that the ADR itself marked 'needs operator confirmation'; that confirmation never happened and the hedge was dropped in transit. These screenshots record what the OLD APP DOES (quirks included); Figma records DESIGN INTENT. They answer different questions and neither supersedes the other.

userPublicHowTo.whatItIs: The author public-library page: everything a given AUTHOR has published. Parity target apps/elitea-ui/src/pages/UserPublic/UserPublic.jsx.
userPublicHowTo.howToReach: Open Agent HUB and click the small round AUTHOR AVATAR at the bottom-left of any agent card (see agents-hub.*.jpeg). Cards with 2 avatars have multiple authors. This is the only in-app entry point.
userPublicHowTo.note: Use an author who has published something — e.g. the author of 'AI Presentation Creator' (85 likes) in Agent HUB. Your own id is 33731, but that library is empty, so it would only show the empty state.
userPublicHowTo.resolved: Captured 2026-08-06. Bare /user-public/ 404s (no :tab). Note the deployed app is version 2.0.4 while the parity baseline apps/elitea-ui is pinned at a55f36cf / 0.4.1863 (2026-07-08) — treat old-SPA route contracts as advisory, not authoritative.
